title: On the cohomological classification of vector bundles on smooth real affine surfaces and threefolds
summary: We study the cohomological classification of vector bundles on smooth real affine surfaces and threefolds. We show that, as was observed in joint work in A. Asok and J. Fasel and with S. Banerjee and J. Fasel, under suitable cohomological assumptions on the real locus of such varieties, this classification mirrors the one obtained on algebraically closed base fields by Mohan Kumar and Murthy and by Asok and Fasel.
